title: Patch: duplicate a deck to try a variant
thread:
**Issue #2096 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2096: Patch: duplicate a deck to try a variant Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ### What it does Trying a variant of a deck today means rebuilding it or editing the original. Add Duplicate to a deck's actions in the decks list and the deck editor. It makes a new deck with the same cards, cosmetics and portrait, named " (copy)" (then "(copy 2)" and so on when that name is taken), and opens it in the editor. Trios naming the original keep naming the original. When the player is at the deck limit, Duplicate is disabled and says why. ### Acceptance - Duplicate makes a new deck with the same cards, cosmetics and portrait and opens it. - The copy's name follows the "(copy)", "(copy 2)" pattern. - The original and its trio slots are unchanged. - At the deck limit, the action is disabled with a reason. - Vitest covers each of the above. ### Blocked by, part of _No response_ --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_ ## Plan _Written by `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40561173358)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ **Goal.** Add **Duplicate** to each deck's row in the `/decks` list and to the open deck's actions in the deck editor. Duplicate makes a new deck with the same cards, portrait (R641) and playmat, backdrop and card-back picks (R1297000). The copy is named ` (copy)`, then ` (copy 2)`, `(copy 3)` and so on while a name is taken, and it opens in the editor. The original deck and every trio slot naming it stay as they were. At `limits.decks` (`MAX_SAVED_DECKS`, R250) Duplicate is disabled in both places and a visible sentence says why. Vitest covers each of these. **Files to touch.** | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/workshop.ts` | change | private `fitName`, exported `copyName` in the "Names" section | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/testids.ts` | change | `DECK_DUPLICATE`, `DECK_DUPLICATE_REASON`, `deckDuplicateId()` | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.tsx` | change | header comment, `duplicateDeck`, `RailProps`/`DeckRowProps`, the row's Duplicate button | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckEditor.tsx` | change | `onDuplicate` prop, Duplicate button, reason line at the cap | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/workshop.css` | change | `.ws-list-item`, `.ws-row-duplicate` (a two-sheet icon), its touch size, a tighter `.ws-actions` on phones | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | five new keys | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | the `game/deckbuilder/` entry mentions Duplicate | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/workshop.test.ts` | change | `copyName` test | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` | change | new `describe("duplicating a deck (#2096)")` | Do not touch: - `sync.ts`: `createDeck` already copies the cards, the portrait and `pickedDeckCosmetics`, and returns null at the cap. - `crates/` (no server change: a copy is a plain `PUT /api/decks/:id`, R256). - `spec/`, `e2e/`. - every `package.json` and lockfile. - `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing: SPEC §9.4 (decks and trios), R250 (cap, D1 name length), R252 (trios name decks by id), R256 (client-minted id, autosave), R641 (portrait), R1297000 (deck picks), R711000 (names in the reader's words). No new ruling (see Open questions). **Steps.** 1. **`workshop.ts`, directly after `nextName`**, add: ```ts /** `make(name)`, with `name` cut (and its trailing spaces dropped) until the whole fits in `max` characters as D1 counts them. */ function fitName(name: string, make: (name: string) => string, max: number): string { const over = [...make(name)].length - max; return over <= 0 ? make(name) : make(clampName(name, Math.max(0, [...name].length - over)).trimEnd()); } /** * #2096: a duplicate's name, ` (copy)`, then ` (copy 2)`, `(copy 3)`, …: the first no name * in `taken` uses (trimmed, any case, as `nextName` compares). `name` is cut so the whole fits in * `nameLength`, or the save's own cut (D1) would take the "(copy)" off again. */ export function copyName(name: string, taken: readonly string[], nameLength: number): string { const used = new Set(taken.map((other) => other.trim().toLowerCase())); for (let number = 1; ; number += 1) { const candidate = fitName( name, (base) => (number === 1 ? t("{name} (copy)", { name: base }) : t("{name} (copy {number})", { name: base, number })), nameLength, ); if (!used.has(candidate.toLowerCase())) return candidate; } } ``` 2. **`testids.ts`, after `DECK_DELETE_CANCEL`**, add: ```ts /** * #2096: Duplicate in the open deck's actions, and the reason it gives when off at the deck limit. * Each row in the list has its own, `deck-duplicate-` (never `deck-row-…`, which the e2e * specs read as the rows). */ export const DECK_DUPLICATE = "deck-duplicate"; export const DECK_DUPLICATE_REASON = "deck-duplicate-reason"; export function deckDuplicateId(deckId: string): string { return `deck-duplicate-${deckId}`; } ``` 3. **`DeckWorkshop.tsx`, imports.** - Line 13 becomes `import { deckCosmeticPatch, pickedDeckCosmetics } from "../../cards/cosmetics.ts";`. - Add `deckDuplicateId` to the `./testids.ts` import. - Add `copyName` to the `./workshop.ts` import. - At the end of the header comment, add: `// #2096: Duplicate, on each deck's row and in its editor, makes a new deck with its cards, portrait and picks under copyName's name, and opens it.` 4. **`DeckWorkshop.tsx`, `DeckRow`.** - `DeckRowProps` gains `atCap: boolean; reasonId: string | undefined; onDuplicate: () => void;`. Destructure them. - Change its `
  • ` to `
  • `. - After the row's closing `` (still inside the `li`), add: ```tsx {/* #2096: drawn as two sheets, in words for a reader and on hover: a worded button would wrap every row of the 208 px rail. */} ``` - Directly after the `.ws-actions` closing ``, add: ```tsx {atCap ? (

    {t("You have {count} decks, the most you can keep. Delete one to duplicate this.", { count: limits.decks })}

    ) : null} ``` 9. **`workshop.css`, after the `.ws-row-dot` rule**, add: ```css /* #2096: a deck's row and its Duplicate, drawn as two sheets, side by side. */ .ws-list-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 4px; } .deckbuilder.app-shell .ws-row-duplicate { position: relative; width: 28px; padding: 0; border-color: var(--line); border-radius: 8px; } .ws-row-duplicate::before, .ws-row-duplicate::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 9px; height: 11px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; } .ws-row-duplicate::before { top: calc(50% - 8px); left: calc(50% - 7px); } /* The front sheet hides the back one's corner. */ .ws-row-duplicate::after { top: calc(50% - 4px); left: calc(50% - 3px); background: inherit; } ``` 10. **`workshop.css`, the phone blocks.** - Inside the existing `@media (max-width: 560px)` block, after `.workshop .db-header`, add: ```css /* #2096: Practice, Copy code, Duplicate and Delete deck stay on one row in a 390 px phone's sidebar (344 px inside), so the pool's first row stays on the first screen (BUILD M5-T1). */ .ws-actions { gap: 6px; } .deckbuilder.app-shell .ws-actions .ws-action { padding-inline: 8px; } ``` - Inside the touch-sizing block `@media (max-width: 760px), (max-height: 500px), (pointer: coarse)`, add `.deckbuilder.app-shell .ws-row-duplicate { width: 44px; }` with the comment `/* #2096: a row's Duplicate takes a finger too. */`. 11. **`zh-CN.json`.** After `"Delete deck": "删除卡组",` add: ```json "Duplicate": "创建副本", "Duplicate {deck}": "为{deck}创建副本", "{name} (copy)": "{name}（副本）", "{name} (copy {number})": "{name}（副本 {number}）", "You have {count} decks, the most you can keep. Delete one to duplicate this.": "你有{count}套卡组，已达上限。删除一套后才能复制这套卡组。", ``` 12. **`apps/web/README.md`, the `game/deckbuilder/` entry.** Replace `(TrioImportPanel.tsx, R340), and autosave with a local mirror of unsaved edits` / `(sync.ts, R256); a trio import is one POST /api/trios/import, never the autosave (R341)` with the lines below. Keep the 24-space indent. ``` (TrioImportPanel.tsx, R340), Duplicate on each deck's row and in its editor (a new deck with its cards, portrait and picks, named " (copy)", #2096), and autosave with a local mirror of unsaved edits (sync.ts, R256); a trio import is one POST /api/trios/import, never the autosave (R341) ``` **Tests.** `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/workshop.test.ts`: import `copyName`. Inside `describe("names")`, add `it("#2096 a copy is ' (copy)', then '(copy 2)' and on, cut to fit the name limit", …)`, asserting with `NAME` (= `DECK_NAME_MAX_LENGTH`): - `copyName("Aggro", ["Aggro"], NAME)` is `"Aggro (copy)"`. - `copyName("Aggro", ["Aggro", " aggro (COPY) "], NAME)` is `"Aggro (copy 2)"`. - `copyName("Aggro", ["Aggro", "Aggro (copy)", "Aggro (copy 2)"], NAME)` is `"Aggro (copy 3)"`. - With `const long = "x".repeat(NAME)`: - `copyName(long, [long], NAME)` is `` `${"x".repeat(NAME - 7)} (copy)` `` and its `[...].length` is `NAME`. - `copyName(long, [long, `${"x".repeat(NAME - 7)} (copy)`], NAME)` is `` `${"x".repeat(NAME - 9)} (copy 2)` ``. - `copyName("Aggro Tempo", [], 13)` is `"Aggro (copy)"` (the cut's trailing space is dropped). `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx`: import `DECK_DUPLICATE`, `DECK_DUPLICATE_REASON` and `deckDuplicateId`. At the end of the file, add `describe("duplicating a deck (#2096)")` with these tests: 1. `it("#2096 Duplicate in the editor makes a deck with the same cards, portrait and picks, opens it and saves it")` - Mount `decks: [{ ...savedDeck("a", "Aggro", ONE, 1), portrait: "gary", tableCosmetic: "table-felt", fieldCosmetic: "field-rain", cardBackCosmetic: "card-back-lacquer" }]`, `initialOpen: { kind: "deck", id: "a" }`. - Before clicking, assert `DECK_DUPLICATE` is enabled and `queryByTestId(DECK_DUPLICATE_REASON)` is null. - Click `DECK_DUPLICATE`. Then: - `DECK_EDITOR` has `data-deck` `"new-1"`. - `DECK_NAME_INPUT` has the value `"Aggro (copy)"`. - `deckRowId("new-1")` has `aria-current="true"` and `data-count` `String(DECK_SIZE)`. - After `tick(DECK_AUTOSAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS)`, `server.decks.get("new-1")` `toMatchObject({ name: "Aggro (copy)", cards: [...ONE], portrait: "gary", tableCosmetic: "table-felt", fieldCosmetic: "field-rain", cardBackCosmetic: "card-back-lacquer" })`. 2. `it("#2096 a row's Duplicate copies that deck, not the open one, and opens the copy from the list")` - Mount decks `a` "Aggro" (`ONE.slice(0, 3)`) and `b` "Brawl" (`TWO.slice(0, 5)`), with no `initialOpen`. - Assert `WORKSHOP` is `data-view="list"`. - Assert `getByRole("button", { name: "Duplicate Brawl" })` is `getByTestId(deckDuplicateId("b"))`, then click it. - Then: - `data-view` is `"editor"`. - The editor is `"new-1"` and the name is `"Brawl (copy)"`. - `DECK_COUNT` has `data-count` `"5"`. 3. `it("#2096 the copy's name takes (copy 2), then (copy 3), while each is taken")` - Mount `a` "Aggro" and `b` "Aggro (copy)", both `[]`, with `a` open. - Click `deckDuplicateId("a")`: the name is `"Aggro (copy 2)"`. - Click it again: the name is `"Aggro (copy 3)"`. - `DECK_CAP` reads `` `4/${String(MAX_SAVED_DECKS)}` ``. 4. `it("#2096 the original and the trio slots naming it are unchanged")` - Mount `a` "Aggro" (`ONE`), `b` "Brawl" (`TWO`) and `savedTrio("t", "Ladder", ["a", "b", null], 3)`, with `a` open. - Click `DECK_DUPLICATE`, then `tick(DECK_AUTOSAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS)`. Then: - `server.calls.map((call) => `${call.op} ${call.id}`)` equals `["putDeck new-1"]`. - `server.decks.get("a")` matches `{ name: "Aggro", cards: [...ONE] }`. - `server.trios.get("t")?.deckIds` equals `["a", "b", null]`. - Click `trioRowId("t")`: the `HTMLSelectElement` values of `trioSlotId(1)`, `trioSlotId(2)` and `trioSlotId(3)` are `"a"`, `"b"` and `""`. 5. `it("#2096 at the deck limit Duplicate is off in the list and the editor, and says why")` - Build `MAX_SAVED_DECKS` decks as in "R250 New deck is off at the cap", and open `d0`. - Editor: - `DECK_DUPLICATE` is disabled. - `DECK_DUPLICATE_REASON` has the text `` `You have ${String(MAX_SAVED_DECKS)} decks, the most you can keep. Delete one to duplicate this.` ``. - Its `aria-describedby` is that note's `id`. - List: `deckDuplicateId("d0")` is disabled, with `aria-describedby` set to `getByTestId(DECK_CAP_REASON).id`. - Click both buttons. `DECK_CAP` still reads `` `${String(MAX_SAVED_DECKS)}/${String(MAX_SAVED_DECKS)}` `` and `DECK_EDITOR` is still `"d0"`. Commands: ``` sh scripts/build-wasm.sh pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/deckbuilder/workshop.test.ts src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts src/wording.test.ts src/game/deckbuilder/messages.test.ts src/game/deckbuilder/browse.test.tsx src/game/deckbuilder/savedBrowse.test.tsx src/routes/decks.test.tsx src/routes/decks-custom.test.tsx src/emotes/PortraitPicker.test.tsx pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm exec eslint apps/web cargo jackioh spec check cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims ``` **Done when.** - [ ] Duplicate is on every deck row (`deck-duplicate-`) and in the editor (`deck-duplicate`). It makes a deck with the same cards, portrait and three picks and opens it (tests 1 and 2). - [ ] Names follow `(copy)`, `(copy 2)`, `(copy 3)`, cut to `DECK_NAME_MAX_LENGTH` (the `copyName` test, test 3). - [ ] The original and its trio slots are unchanged, and no PUT goes out but the copy's (test 4). - [ ] At the cap, both buttons are disabled with a visible reason linked by `aria-describedby` (test 5). - [ ] The five zh-CN keys are added, and `i18n.test.ts` passes. - [ ] Every command above passes, plus the harness's checks (rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests). - [ ] No file outside the table changed. **Risks.** - **Phone layout (BUILD M5-T1).** I measured in headless Chromium with Inter. The sidebar is 344 px wide inside at 390 px. Practice + Copy code + Duplicate + Delete deck take 373 px at today's padding, so the row wraps. A wrap pushes the pool's first row off the first screen, which the daily `e2e/cypress/component/deckbuilder-layout.cy.tsx` spec checks with a full deck open. With step 10's gap of 6 px and inline padding of 8 px, the row takes 334.8 px. Keep those exact values, and do not add words to any `.ws-actions` button. On phones narrower than about 370 px the row can still wrap, and no test covers that. - **Rail width.** The desktop rail is 208 px (186 px inside). A worded per-row button wraps every row's count and chip (measured), so the row gets the 28 px icon. Even so, a row whose chip is long (such as "3 not owned") can wrap its meta line, as "Practice only" already does. - **e2e selectors.** The specs pick rows with `[data-testid^="deck-row-"]`. The new id must not start with `deck-row-`. - **Ownership refusals.** The server refuses a portrait or pick the account does not own (R1827000, R1833000). A copy of a deck holding such a legacy pick is refused like any save of the original would be, and the refusal shows on the copy (R256). Nothing to build. - **Hidden information and determinism.** Neither is affected: client only, nothing enters `view_for`, the engine or a replay. Rule 7 holds because the server still enforces the cap (`decks_upsert`), and the client only disables the button early. **Open questions.** These are decisions I made that the task did not settle; a person may overrule any of them. - **No ruling.** Duplicate is a deck-workshop convenience over the existing upsert and caps (R250, R252, R256), like #2007's "Practice with this deck", which added none. Rejected: a note R2096000 plus an §9.4 line. - **Literal names.** Duplicating "Aggro (copy)" gives "Aggro (copy) (copy)", following the issue's ` (copy)` exactly. Rejected: stripping a trailing "(copy n)" first, which would mean parsing a localised suffix. - **The name is cut to fit.** The original's name is shortened so the suffix survives the 40-character cap. Rejected: letting the save's cut drop " (copy)", which would repeat the original's name. - **List action shape.** A per-row icon button whose accessible name and tooltip are "Duplicate {deck}". Rejected: a worded per-row button (wraps the narrow rail) and a group-head button acting on the open deck (on a phone it is unclear which deck it copies). - **Editor reason.** The editor states its own reason at the cap, because a phone's editor half hides the rail's note. - **Save timing.** The copy saves through the usual debounce, not at once. ````
